Broadway News Schedule of Upcoming and Announced Broadway Shows

See what’s coming soon, what’s premiering out of town, and what’s in development.
By James Miller
July 30, 2026

This list is updated regularly. It is organized by start of previews.

Playbill will update these listings when new information is made available. For a list of all Broadway-related COVID-19 protocols, please click here.

2026-2027 SEASON

PARANORMAL ACTIVITY
Theatre: August Wilson Theatre
First Preview: August 14, 2026
Opening: August 25, 2026
Starring: Cher Álvarez, Travis A. Knight, Shannon Cochran, Andrea Syglowski
Writer: Levi Holloway
Director: Felix Barrett
About: A new stage experience based on the Paranormal Activity film series.  The show has previously played Chicago and London.

SCHOOL GIRLS; OR, THE AFRICAN MEAN GIRLS PLAY
Theatre: Samuel J. Friedman Theatre
First Preview: September 8, 2026
Opening: September 28, 2026
Starring: Lucia Aremu, Denée Benton, Patina Miller, Erin Morton, Nia Otchere-Sarfo, Jordan Rice, Jasmine Amy Rogers, Heather Alicia Simms
Writer: Jocelyn Bioh
Director: Whitney White
About: A new production of Jocelyn Bioh's comedy about Ghanese school girls competing in a beauty contest.  The play originally played Off-Broadway's MCC Theater in 2017.

THE IMAGINARY INVALID
Theatre: Todd Haimes Theatre
First Preview: September 25, 2026
Opening: October 22, 2026
Starring: Bill Irwin
Writers: Molière (playwright), Bill Irwin (adaptation)
Director: Brandon J. Dirden
About: A new adaptation of Molière's classic comedy about a rich hypochondriac and the scheming people around him.

OTHER DESERT CITIES
Theatre: Hudson Theatre
First Preview: September 29, 2026
Opening: October 18, 2026
Starring: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris, Allison Janney, Joe Keery, Lily Rabe
Writers: Jon Robin Baitz
Director: John Benjamin Hickey
About: An all-star revival of Jon Robin Baitz's award-winning play about a family whose secret is about to be exposed in a tell-all memoir.

860
Theatre: Imperial Theatre
First Preview: October 1, 2026
Opening: October 21, 2026
Starring: Billy Crystal
Writer: Billy Crystal
Director: Scott Ellis
About: Billy Crystal returns to Broadway in an autobiographical solo show centered around the house his family lost in the Palisades fire.

A FEW GOOD MEN
Theatre: Vivian Beaumont Theatre
First Preview: October 8, 2026
Opening: October 29, 2026
Starring: Bradley Whitford, Tom Blyth
Writer: Aaron Sorkin
Director: Michael Arden
About: A revival of Aaron Sorkin's classic drama about corruption within the U.S. military.

WANTED
Theatre: James Earl Jones Theatre
First Preview: October 15, 2026
Opening: November 8, 2026
Starring: Solea Pfeiffer, Liisi LaFontaine, Luke James, Ledisi
Writers: Ross Baum (music), Angelica Chéri (book & lyrics)
Director: Stevie Walker-Webb
About: A new musical inspired by the true story of Mary and Martha Clarke, African-American twin sisters who take extraordinary measures to settle their mother’s sharecropper debt and save her home. The musical played Signature Theatre and Paper Mill Playhouse under the title Gun & Powder.

THE FANTASTICKS
Theatre: Hayes Theatre
First Preview: October 22, 2026
Opening: November 16, 2026
Writers: Tom Jones (book and lyrics), Harvey Schmidt (music)
Director: Christopher Gattelli
About: The world's longest-running musical, revised as a gay love story, is aiming to make its Broadway premiere.

MUCH ADO ABOUT NOTHING
Theatre: Winter Garden Theatre
First Preview: October 31, 2026
Opening: November 19, 2026
Starring: Tom Hiddleston, Hayley Atwell
Writer: William Shakespeare
Director: Jamie Lloyd
About: William Shakespeare's witty romantic comedy returns to Broadway in a production that premiered in London in spring 2025.

GALILEO
Theatre: Shubert Theatre
First Preview: November 10, 2026
Opening: December 6, 2026
Starring: Raúl Esparza, Joy Woods, Jeremy Kushnier
Writers: Zoe Sarnak and Michael Weiner (music & lyrics), Danny Strong (book)
Director: Michael Mayer
About: A musical centered on the historical scientist Galileo Galilei.  It premiered at Berkeley Rep in 2024.

INTER ALIA
Theatre: Music Box Theatre
First Preview: November 10, 2026
Opening: December 1, 2026
Starring: Rosamund Pike
Writer: Suzie Miller
Director: Justin Martin
About: A new drama about a London Crown Court judge who must hold her family together when an unthinkable event rocks their life.  It premiered at London's National Theatre in 2025 and transferred to the West End.

DOLLY: A TRUE ORIGINAL MUSICAL
Theatre: St. James Theatre
First Preview: December 7, 2026
Opening: January 19, 2027
Writers: Dolly Parton (book, music, and lyrics), Maria S. Schlatter (book)
Director: Bartlett Sher
About: A new bio-musical inspired by the life and career of Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Dolly Parton. Its premiere production played Nashville in 2025.

AWAKE AND SING!
Theatre: Samuel J. Friedman Theatre
First Preview: December 15, 2026
Opening: January 7, 2027
Starring: Danny Burstein, Micaela Diamond, Jessica Hecht, Will Pullen, Jeremy Shamos
Writer: Clifford Odets
Director: Tyne Rafaeli
About: A revival of Clifford Odets's landmark play about a Depression-era Brooklyn family.

MIX AND MASTER
Theatre: Todd Haimes Theatre
First Preview: January 5, 2027
Opening: January 27, 2027
Starring: Ruben Santaigo-Hudson, Kara Young
Writer: Dominique Morisseau
Director: Kamilah Forbes
About: A new play about a rising DJ's efforts to save the last record shop in Brooklyn.

EVITA
Theatre: Winter Garden Theatre
First Preview: February 27, 2027
Opening: March 25, 2027
Starring: Rachel Zegler
Writers: Andrew Lloyd Webber (music), Tim Rice (lyrics)
Director: Jamie Lloyd
About: A revival of the classic musical about the rise and death of Eva Peron. This production premiered in London's West End in 2025.

PURPLE RAIN
Theatre: Majestic Theatre
First Preview: March 12, 2027
Opening: April 12, 2027
Writers: Prince (music), Peter Duchan (book)
Director: Saheem Ali
About: A new stage adaptation of Prince’s legendary film and album, depicting an up-and-coming rock musician. The show premiered in October 2025 in Prince's hometown of Minneapolis.

GLORIA
Theatre: Hayes Theatre
First Preview: March 17, 2027
Opening: April 5, 2027
Writer: Branden Jacobs-Jenkins
Director: Evan Cabnet
About: The first Broadway production of the Pulitzer Prize finalist comedy about ambitious magazine assistants who seize a traumatic event to get ahead professionally.

THE SOUND OF MUSIC
Theatre: Vivian Beaumont Theatre
First Preview: March 23, 2027
Opening: April 15, 2027
Starring: Jasmine Amy Rogers
Writers: Richard Rodgers (music), Oscar Hammerstein II (lyrics), Howard Lindsay & Russel Crowse (book)
Director: Lear deBessonet
About: A revival of Rodgers & Hammerstein's beloved musical based on the lives of the von Trapp family.

PADDINGTON THE MUSICAL
Theatre: Al Hirschfeld Theatre
First Preview: March 30, 2027
Opening: April 18, 2027
Writers: Tom Fletcher (music & lyrics), Jessica Swale (book)
Director: Luke Sheppard
About: The beloved little bear Paddington comes to Broadway in this transfer production of the hit, Olivier Award-winning musical from London.

THE FULL MONTY
Theatre: Todd Haimes Theatre
First Preview: April 3, 2027
Opening: April 25, 2027
Writers: David Yazbek (music & lyrics), Terrence McNally (book)
Director: Leigh Silverman
About: A revival of the hit musical comedy about unemployed men putting on a strip show.

ANNOUNCED FOR 2026-2027 SEASON WITHOUT CONFIRMED DATE OR VENUE

DREAMGIRLS
First Preview: Fall 2026
Writers: Henry Krieger (music), Tom Eyen (book and lyrics)
Director: Camille A. Brown
About: Broadway's first all-new production of the beloved musical will open in fall 2026.

WARRIORS
Theatre: Lunt-Fontanne Theatre
First Preview: March 2027
Writers: Lin-Manuel Miranda & Eisa Davis (book, music & lyrics)
Directors: Jenny Koons & Andy Blankenbuehler
About: A musical based on the cult 1979 film The Warriors, in which a fictitious New York City gang is framed for murdering a rival gang's leader.  The musical released a concept album in 2024.

MONTAUK
Theatre: Samuel J. Friedman Theatre
First Preview: Spring 2027
Starring: Laura Linney
Writer: David Hare
Director: Daniel Sullivan
About: A world premiere play about two artists whose lives are entangled both professionally and romantically.

CAT ON A HOT TIN ROOF
First Preview: Spring 2027
Writer: Tennessee Williams
Director: Sam Gold
About: A revival of Tennessee Williams' Pulitzer Prize-winning play about the scheming family of a dying tycoon.

THREE DAYS OF RAIN
First Preview: February 2027
Starring: François Arnaud, David Corenswet, Yvonne Strahovski
Writer: Richard Greenberg
Director: Anna D. Shapiro
About: A revival of Richard Greenberg's Pulitzer Prize finalist play that juxtaposes the children of famous architects and the architects themselves as young people.

LET THE GOOD TIMES ROLL
Writer: Jack Viertel (concept & book)
Director: Sara Edwards
About: A new jukebox musical built around the music of New Orleans.  It premiered at Phoenix Theatre Company in summer 2025

PRIVATE LIVES
Writer: Noël Coward
About: The classic 1931 comedy about a divorced couple reigniting their spark will return to Broadway in 2026.

IN THE WORKS

13 GOING ON 30
Creative Team: Josh Goldsmith and Cathy Yuspa (book), Alan Zachary and Michael Weiner (music and lyrics), Andy Fickman (director)
About: New musical based on the 2004 hit movie of the same title about a gawky teenage girl who uses “wishing dust” to transform herself into a glamorous adult. The musical debuted at Manchester Opera House in 2025 and will play Toronto's Mirvish Theatre in 2026.

ALI
Creative Team: Clint Dyer (book, lyrics, director), Teddy Abrams (music), Q-Tip (music producer, co-lyricist), Richard Willis (producer)
About: A new musical celebrating the life and legacy of the heavyweight boxing champion and humanitarian Muhammad Ali.  The production announced plans to premiere in Chicago.

ANNE OF GREEN GABLES: A NEW MUSICAL
Creative Team: Matte O’Brien (book & lyrics), Matt Vinson (music), Jenn Thompson (director), Eleanore Scott (choreographer), Eric Cornell (producer), Jack Sennott (producer)
About: A contemporary adaptation of the beloved novel, the musical made its world premiere at Goodspeed Musicals in 2022 and held industry presentations in February 2024.

BEAT STREET
Creative Team: Nas (new material, producer), Arthur Baker (producer), Michael Holman (producer), Richard Fearn (producer)
About: A new musical based on the 1984 hip-hop film classic.

COAL MINER'S DAUGHTER
Creative Team: Jeanine Tesori (music production); Sam Gold (director); Patsy Lynn and Nancy Russell (consulting producers); Kristin Caskey, Mike Isaacson, Bee Carrozzini, ATG Entertainment (produers)
Cast: Sutton Foster
About: A musical about the life of country music star Loretta Lynn, previously presented as an autobiography and a 1980 movie.

COCO
Creative Team: Michael Giacchino (music), Robert Lopez and Kristen Anderson-Lopez (music & lyrics), Disney (producer)
About: A musical adaptation of the Pixar animated film that explores identity and legacy through Dia de los Muertos.

CRAZY RICH ASIANS
Creative Team: Helen Park (music), Amanda Green & Tat Tong (lyrics), Leah Nanako Winkler (book), Jon M. Chu (director), Warner Bros. Theatre Ventures (producer)
About: A musical adaptation of the hit Warner Bros. romantic comedy.

DAMN YANKEES
Creative Team: Richard Adler and Jerry Ross (music and lyrics), George Abbott and Douglass Wallop (book), Will Power and Doug Wright (new adaptation), Lynn Ahrens (additional lyrics), Sergio Trujillo (director/choreographer), Haley Swindal and Julie Boardman (producers).
About: One of America’s most beloved musicals is coming back, spit-shined for a new generation, following a run at Washington, D.C.’s Arena Stage.

THE DEVIL WEARS PRADA
Creative Team: Elton John (music), Shaina Taub (lyrics), Kate Wetherhead (book), Jerry Mitchell (director), Kevin McCollum (producer)
About: New musical based on Lauren Weisberger’s 2003 novel and the 2006 film about a woman who becomes assistant to the notorious editor of a topline fashion magazine. A Chicago pre-Broadway tryout ran in summer 2022, and a West End production opened in December 2024.

DIRTY DANCING
Creative Team: Eleanor Bergstein (book), Lonny Price (director), Lionsgate and The Path Entertainment Group (producers)
About: A musical adaptation of the beloved 1987 film.

FAHRENHEIT 451
Creative Team: Martyna Majok (playwright), Glass Half Full Productions and Aaron Glick (producers)
About: A play adaptation of Ray Bradbury's classic novel, about a near-future in which firemen are made to burn books.

GATSBY
Creative Team: Florence Welch (lyrics), Florence Welch and Thomas Bartlett (music), Martyna Majok (book), Jeanie O'Hare (story consultant), Rachel Chavkin (director), Sonya Tayeh (choreographer), Jordan Roth (producer)
About: A musical adaptation of F. Scott Fitzgerald's classic novel, which entered the public domain in 2021. It premiered at the American Repertory Theatre in Cambridge, MA, in 2024.

GET HAPPY
Creative Team: Cheri Steinkellner (book and additional lyrics), Donna Feore (direction and choreography), Steve Peters and Michael Londra of VenuWorks Theatricals, Greg & Marissa Frankenfield of Excelsior Entertainment, (producers)
About: A new musical adapted from the Judy Garland-Gene Kelly MGM/Warner Bros. film musical Summer Stock. A premiere production titled after the film played Goodspeed Musicals in 2023, and a New York developmental reading starring Corbin Bleu and Stephanie Styles was held in January 2025.

GLORY RIDE
Creative Team: Victoria Buccholz (book, music, and lyrics), Todd Buchholz (book), Federico Bellone (director), Delaware Theatre Company (producer)
About: A new musical based on the life of Tour de France champion Gino Bartali.  The musical premiered in London, and it will make its American debut at Delaware Theatre Company in February 2026.

THE GREATEST SHOWMAN
Creative Team: Benj Pasek & Justin Paul (music and lyrics), Tim Federle (book), Casey Nicholaw (director and choreographer), Disney (producer)
About: A stage adaptation of the movie musical starring Hugh Jackman as P.T. Barnum.  It will premiere in the United Kingdom in spring 2026.

THE GRISWOLDS' BROADWAY VACATION
Creative Team: David Rossmer and Steve Rosen (book, music, and lyrics), Donna Feore (director and choreographer), Ken Davenport (producer)
About: Based on the characters from the Warner Bros. movie franchise, the musical made its world premiere in Fall 2022 at the 5th Avenue Theatre in Seattle.

GIULIA: THE POISON QUEEN OF PALERMO
Creative Team: Jennifer Nettles (book, music and lyrics), Rebecca Taichman (director)
About: The country star has her eye on bringing another merry murderess to the stage: 17th-century professional poisoner Giulia Tofana. The musical will premiere at Off-Broadway's Perelman Performing Arts Center in June 2026.

HAPPY FEET
Creative Team: Douglas Lyons (book), Michael Arden (director), Ayodele Casel and Lauren Yalango-Grant & Christopher “Cree” Grant (choreography), Dori Berinstein (producer)
About: A musical adaptation of the Academy Award-winning Warner Bros. animated film about a tap dancing penguin.

HIPPEST TRIP: THE SOUL TRAIN MUSICAL
Creative Team: Dominique Morisseau (book), Kamilah Forbes (director), Camille. Brown (choreographer), Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, Tony Cornelius, Anthony E. Zuiker, and Shawn Gee (executive producers)
About: The story of producer Don Cornelius, who created the long-running TV variety show Soul Train with a score including soul and R&B songs showcased in the series. A world premiere production played at ACT in San Francisco in 2023.

IMITATION OF LIFE
Creative Team: John Legend (music & lyrics), Lynn Nottage (book), Liesl Tommy (director), Universal Theatrical Group (producer)
About: A new musical based on the Fannie Hurst novel that inspired two Universal feature films.  Its world premiere production will play Off-Broadway's The Shed in fall 2026.

IN DREAMS
Creative Team: Roy Orbison (songs), David West Read (book), Luke Sheppard (director)
About: A jukebox musical featuring the songs of rock and roll singer-songwriter Roy Orbison. It premiered in England in 2023 with Lena Hall in the lead role.

THE INTERESTINGS
Creative Team: Sara Bareilles (music & lyrics), Sarah Ruhl (book), Matt Ross (producer)
About: A new musical based on the Meg Wolitzer novel.

JAMES BROWN THE MUSICAL
Creative Team: Deanna Brown-Thomas (book & producer), Jeremy E. Cormier (book, director, producer)
About: A new musical about the life of James Brown, often referred to as the Godfather of Soul.

THE KARATE KID
Creative Team: Drew Gasparini (music and lyrics), Robert Mark Kamen (book), Amon Miyamoto (director)
About: A new musical based on the 1984 Columbia Pictures film inspired by Robert Mark Kamen’s original, semi-autobiographical story. It had its pre-Broadway production in St. Louis starring John Cardoza, Kate Baldwin, and Alan H. Green.

KOWALSKI
Creative Team: Greg Ostrin (playwright), Colin Hanlon (director)
About: A play about the first meeting of Tennessee Williams and Marlon Brando. It previously played The Duke on 42nd Street in Winter 2025.

LA LA LAND
Creative Team: Justin Hurwitz (music), Benj Pasek & Justin Paul (lyrics), Ayad Akhtar & Matthew Decker (book), Bartlett Sher (director)
About: A stage adaptation of Damien Chazelle's Academy Award-winning movie musical.

LIKE WATER FOR CHOCOLATE
Creative Team: Lisa Loomer (book), Laura Esquivel (source material), La Santa Cecilia (music), La Santa Cecilia and Quiara Alegría Hudes (lyrics), Michael Mayer (director)
About: An exclusive preview of two songs from the musical debuted during ¡Viva Broadway! Hear Our Voices in October 2020.

LITTLE DANCER
Creative Team: Lynn Ahrens and Stephen Flaherty (score), Susan Stroman (director and choreographer)
About: The musical about Degas and ballerina Marie had a production at Seattle's 5th Avenue Theatre in 2019 and a concert presentation in London in 2025.

THE LITTLE DOG LAUGHED
Creative Team: Douglas Carter Beane (playwright), Sheryl Kaller (director), Barbara Manocherian (producer)
About: A revival of the comedy about a Hollywood agent trying to cover up her client's homosexuality.  A private industry presentation starred Billy Porter and Luke Macfarlane.

LOCH NESS
Creative Team: Sandy Rustin (book), Marshall Pailet (music), A.D. Penedo (lyrics), Marshall Pailet (director)
About: A new musical about a Scottish girl searching for the Loch Ness Monster.  Its world premiere will open at New Jersey's Two River Theater in Spring 2027.

MIDNIGHT IN THE GARDEN OF GOOD AND EVIL
Creative Team: Jason Robert Brown (music & lyrics), Taylor Mac (book), Rob Ashford (director)
About: A musical adaptation of John Berendt's 1994 Pulitzer finalist novel. It premiered at Chicago's Goodman Theatre in summer 2024.

NANCY DREW AND THE MYSTERY AT SPOTLIGHT MANOR: A MUSICAL
Creative Team: Sarah Kernochan (book), Alan Menken (music), Nell Benjamin (lyrics), James Lapine (director)
About: A live stage adaptation based on the beloved teen girl detective.

THE NANNY
Creative Team: Fran Drescher and Peter Marc Jacobson (book), Rachel Bloom and the late Adam Schlesinger (score), Marc Bruni (director)
About: A musical based on the popular sitcom series that ran during the '90s, starring Drescher.

OBSESSED, THE STORY OF DIANE WARREN…SO FAR
Creative team: Joe DiPietro (book), Kathleen Marshall (director)
About: A new musical based on the incredible life of Diane Warren, one of the most famous and successful songwriters of all time.

PAL JOEY
Creative Team: Richard Rodgers (music), Lorenz Hart (lyrics), John O'Hara (original book), Richard LaGravenese (new book), Savion Glover & Tony Goldwyn (directors)
About: The primary setting for this classic musical has been re-imagined as a South Side Chicago nightclub in the 1940s.  This revisal premiered at New York City Center in 2023, and it will next play Washington, DC's Arena Stage in January 2026.

PARTICLE FEVER
Creative Team: Bear McCreary and Zoe Sarnak (music & lyrics), David Henry Hwang (book), Leigh Silverman (director), Megan Kingery and Annie Roney (producers)
About: A musical based on the particle physics documentary of the same name, telling the story of the discovery of the "God particle."

THE QUEEN'S GAMBIT
Creative Team: Mitski (music & lyrics), Eboni Booth (book), Whitney White (director)
About: A new musical based on the 1983 novel, which was also adapted into a hit Netflix miniseries.

THE SECRET GARDEN
Creative Team: Lucy Simon (music), Marsha Norman (book and lyrics), Warren Carlyle (director)
About: Revival of the 1991 musical based on Frances Hodgson Burnett’s story about an orphan girl who finds renewal when she discovers a locked, dead garden and brings it back to life. The Broadway-bound revival played the Ahmanson Theatre in Los Angeles in 2023.

SIDNEY
Creative team: Charles Randolph-Wright (playwright), Ruben Santiago-Hudson (director)
About: A new play about the life of Oscar winner and Tony nominee Sidney Poitier, based on Poitier's best-selling autobiography The Measure of a Man.

SINATRA THE MUSICAL
Creative Team: Joe DiPietro (book), Kathleen Marshall (director)
About: A new musical based on the life and career of the legendary artist Frank Sinatra. It will open in London's West End in June 2026.

SING STREET
Creative Team: Gary Clark and John Carney (music & lyrics), Enda Walsh (book), Rebecca Taichman (director)
About: The show, based on the 2016 film, explores the power of first love and music against the backdrop of 1980s Dublin. It has played productions Off-Broadway, in Boston, and in London.

SLIPPIN' THROUGH THE CRACKS
Creative Team: Bobby Rush (music & lyrics), Bobby Rush & Stephen Lloyd Helper (book), Stephen Lloyd Helper & Arminda Thomas (co-directors)
About: An autobiographical musical about Grammy-winning blues musician Bobby Rush.

STUDIO 54 THE MUSICAL
Creative Team: Chad Hodge (book), Sergio Trujillo (director & choreographer), Robert Greenblatt and Neil Meron (producers)
About: A musical about the legendary New York City nightclub.

SUGAR DADDY
Creative Team: Sam Morrison (playwright), Stephen Brackett (director)
About: Sam Morrison's solo play is about transforming grief into humor on a journey of love, loss, diabetes, seagull attacks, and a few extraordinary coincidences. It previously played at Edinburgh Festival Fringe and Off-Broadway's SoHo Playhouse.

THE TEN
Creative Team: Future Cut and Emily Phillips (music & lyrics), Nambi E. Kelley (book), Ruben Santiago-Hudson (director), Ken Davenport, Primary Wave Music, Sandi Moran (producers)
About: A new musical loosely based on Moses and the Ten Commandments and inspired by the power and spiritual energy of gospel.

THELMA & LOUISE
Creative Team: Neko Case (music & lyrics), Callie Khouri & Haley Feiffer (book), Trip Cullman (director)
About: A musical adaptation of the beloved 1991 about two friends on the run from the law. Amanda Seyfried performed in a workshop.

TRADING PLACES
Creative Team: Alan Zachary & Michael Weiner (music & lyrics), Thomas Lennon (book), Fatima Robinson (choreography), Kenny Leon (director).
About: A stage adaptation of the 1984 Paramount Pictures film, written by Timothy Harris and Herschel Weingrod. An earlier, developmental production look place at the Alliance Theatre in Atlanta in 2022. Projected for Broadway in the 2026-2027 season.

A TRANSPARENT MUSICAL
Creative Team: Faith Soloway (music & lyrics), MJ Kaufman & Joey Soloway (book), Amazon Studios & Eva Price (producers)
About: A new musical inspired by the hit Amazon Prime television series.

UNLOCK'D
Creative Team: Derek Gregor (music), Sam Carner (lyrics)
About: A fantasy musical about fairies and gnomes meddling in the love lives of young royals. This production will play Arizona's Phoenix Theatre Company in spring 2027.

WAKING NED DEVINE
Creative team: Markéta Irglová and Glen Hansard (music and lyrics), David Hein (book), John Doyle (director), Robert Cole and Mary Beth O’Connor (producers)
About: New musical based on the 1998 Fox Searchlight film written and directed by Kirk Jones.

THE WANDERER
Creative team: Charles Messina (book), Kenneth Ferrone (director), Sarah O’Gleby (choreography), Jill Menza and Charles Messina (producers)
About: New musical based on the life and music of Rock & Roll Hall-of-Famer Dion DiMucci.  A premiere production played the Paper Mill Playhouse in 2022.
